info.description: Git configuration was detected via the pattern /.git/config and log file on passed URLs.

request:
GET /.git/config HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8899
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:95.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/95.0
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 104
Content-Type: text/plain
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:26:16 GMT

[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	bare = false
[remote "origin"]
	url = https://example.com/repo.git
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:95.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/95.0' 'http://127.0.0.1:8899/.git/config'
